# QS-CFW-9852-71 Quality specification - axle hub CFW-9852-71 (4140)

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-9852-71

## Scope
This quality specification defines the acceptance criteria and inspection requirements for forged axle hub CFW-9852-71 (4140) produced at Plant P1. It applies to all production lots and to material identified as CFW-9852-71 delivered under this document.

## Requirements
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material / Part | CFW-9852-71 (4140) |
| Hardness | The hardness range for axle hub CFW-9852-71 (CFW-9852-71) is 34-40 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for axle hub CFW-9852-71 (CFW-9852-71) is ±0.06 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for axle hub CFW-9852-71 (CFW-9852-71) is 73.0 kg. |

Notes:
- All characteristics in the table are mandatory acceptance criteria. Non-listed features shall be conformed to print and process control documents for CFW-9852-71.

## Inspection method
1. Hardness: Perform Rockwell hardness testing according to company lab procedure using HRC scale. Record readings and calculate conformity against the hardness range: The hardness range for axle hub CFW-9852-71 (CFW-9852-71) is 34-40 HRC.
2. Bore diameter: Measure bore using calibrated bore gauge or CMM. Verify bore measurements meet the specified tolerance: The bore diameter tolerance for axle hub CFW-9852-71 (CFW-9852-71) is ±0.06 mm.
3. Weight: Verify forging weight on calibrated scale prior to machining. Confirm that the forging does not exceed the specified maximum: The maximum forging weight for axle hub CFW-9852-71 (CFW-9852-71) is 73.0 kg.
4. Inspection records: Complete inspection form and attach sample readings. Store records per document control retention practice.

## Nonconformance handling
- Any item failing to meet the Requirements table shall be segregated and tagged nonconforming. Disposition options: rework (if applicable), scrap, or return to supplier.
- For hardness, bore diameter, or weight nonconformances, notify Quality and document root cause and corrective action. Record disposition and verification activities on the nonconformance report.
- Re-inspection after corrective action must address only the failed characteristic(s) and include documented evidence of conformity to the specified requirement(s) listed above.
